comments.note: BreakTests.php correctly uses self::buildNotSupportedComment('break') from HubLTestCase rather than hardcoding the format string — good DRY practice that keeps tests resilient to comment-format changes.

The single test_basic() is the right scope: Break takes no parameters or variants, so exactly one test case is sufficient. ShowSnippetTests needed multiple variants because ShowSnippet accepts URL-encoding/decoding/noHTML flags; there is no equivalent surface area for Break.
